chunks: Even if those who did wrong had wrong possessed whatever is in the earth entirely and as much more with it, they would offer it to ransom themselves from the evil of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection; and there would appear to them from Allah that which they did not expect.
ai.seo_question: What will the sinners offer to ransom themselves from punishment on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zumar underscores the futility of material wealth as a ransom when the soul is confronted with the reality of divine justice, emphasizing that the punishment will manifest in ways beyond human calculation. It serves as a profound reminder of the suddenness of accountability, where the 'evil of the punishment' reveals itself not just as physical torment but as the spiritual regret of those who were heedless. This aligns with the Shia understanding of *Barzakh* and *Qiyamah*, where the true value of one's deeds is finally realized.
